items.exampleEn: A glint in the grass turned out to be a lost key.
items.exampleZh: 草地裡的一道閃光，原來是一把遺失的鑰匙。

items.exampleEn: It's inconvenient to carry so many bags on the bus.
items.exampleZh: 在公車上拿這麼多袋子很不方便。

items.exampleEn: The school bus has an auxiliary door at the back.
items.exampleZh: 校車後面有一扇備用的門。

items.exampleEn: He is very possessive of his toys.
items.exampleZh: 他對自己的玩具占有慾很強。

items.exampleEn: The crowd was uplifted by the singer's words.
items.exampleZh: 群眾被歌手的話鼓舞得精神振奮。

items.exampleEn: The house looks brand-new after the painting.
items.exampleZh: 粉刷之後，房子看起來像全新的一樣。

items.exampleEn: On hot days, I carry a small hand-held fan.
items.exampleZh: 天氣熱的時候，我會帶一支小小的手持電風扇。

items.exampleEn: Her navy blue dress looked great.
items.exampleZh: 她那件海軍藍的洋裝很好看。

items.sentenceEn: Is this computer brand-new or used?
items.sentenceZh: 這台電腦是全新的還是二手的？

items.audioEn: Sorry, Monday morning is inconvenient for me. Can we meet on Tuesday instead?
items.audioZh: 抱歉，星期一早上我不方便。我們可以改星期二見面嗎？
items.questionZh: 說話者希望什麼時候見面？

items.sentenceEn: The uniform is navy blue with white lines.
items.sentenceZh: 制服是海軍藍配白線條。

items.sentenceEn: I saw a glint of light in the dark forest.
items.sentenceZh: 我在黑暗的森林裡看見一道閃光。

items.stemEn: The ____ library opened last week, and it's already full of people.
items.stemZh: 全新的圖書館上週開幕，已經擠滿了人。

items.stemEn: The shop closes at five, which is ____ for people who work late.
items.stemZh: 這家店五點就關門，對工作到很晚的人很不方便。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, my mom took me shopping for a brand-new jacket. I chose a navy blue one. In the store, a man was filming with a hand-held camera, and a glint of light from it hit my eyes. My little brother wanted the same jacket, but I didn't want him to have it. My mom said I was being too possessive, and my brother felt frustrated. The store was far from the bus stop, which was a bit inconvenient. When the lights suddenly went out, the store used its auxiliary power, so nobody panicked. After shopping, we ate ice cream, and I felt uplifted.
items.passageZh: 上週六，媽媽帶我去買一件全新的外套。我選了一件海軍藍的。店裡有一位男士正用手持攝影機在拍攝，攝影機反射的一道閃光照到了我的眼睛。我弟弟想要一樣的外套，但我不想讓他也有。媽媽說我占有慾太強了，弟弟覺得很挫折。這家店離公車站很遠，有點不方便。燈突然熄滅時，店裡啟用了備用電力，所以沒有人驚慌。逛完街後，我們去吃冰淇淋，我覺得心情振奮。

questions.questionZh: 店裡的燈熄滅時發生了什麼？
options: 大家都嚇得往門口跑出去

questions.questionZh: 媽媽為什麼說作者占有慾太強？
options: 因為作者搶了弟弟的冰淇淋
因為作者把店裡所有的海軍藍外套都買下來了
因為作者不想讓弟弟買一樣的外套

items.promptZh: 他戴著一頂海軍藍的帽子。
referenceEn: He is wearing a navy blue hat.
He wears a navy blue hat.
rubricZh: navy blue 表示「海軍藍的」，例如 a navy blue hat 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在進行式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 uplifted 造一個句子，說說什麼讓你覺得精神振奮。
referenceEn: I feel uplifted when I listen to my favorite songs.
I felt uplifted after my team won the game.
rubricZh: uplifted 表示「振奮的」，例如 feel uplifted 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式或過去式等）
